meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过统一API查询多个生物数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在一次工作流中查询多个生物信息数据库
copy.tagline_en: Query multiple bio databases with a unified API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bioinformatics databases in one workflow

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能通过一套统一的编程接口,访问约 40 个生物数据库(如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等),做跨库查询、ID 转换和序列相似性搜索,并统一返回结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求跨多个生物数据库(如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等)做整合查询、ID 映射或跨库分析,或需要运行 BLAST 序列检索时触发。

say.text: 用 UniProt 查 P43403 的蛋白序列,并映射到 KEGG ID
say.note: 返回序列和转换后的数据库标识符

say.text: 在 KEGG 里搜 Geldanamycin 这个化合物,再映射到 ChEMBL
say.note: 返回 KEGG 化合物编号和对应的 ChEMBL ID

say.text: 用 BLASTP 对这段蛋白序列在 uniprotkb 库里搜相似序列
say.note: BLAST 是异步任务,先查状态再取结果

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use a unified Python interface to access ~40 bioinformatics databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL), enabling cross-database queries, identifier mapping, and sequence similarity searches.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for integrated queries across multiple biological databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL), identifier mapping, cross-database analysis, or BLAST sequence searches.

say_en.text: Look up UniProt P43403 sequence and map it to KEGG ID
say_en.note: Returns the sequence and converted identifiers.

say_en.text: Search Geldanamycin in KEGG and map to ChEMBL
say_en.note: Returns KEGG compound ID and ChEMBL ID.

say_en.text: Run BLASTP on this protein sequence against uniprotkb
say_en.note: BLAST is async; check job status before fetching results.
